overview: Depression is a common mental disorder characterized by a depressed mood or loss of pleasure or interest in activities for long periods of time, affecting all aspects of life. It can result from or lead to problems at school and at work, and can happen to anyone. Depression is different from regular mood changes and feelings about everyday life.
symptoms: loss of pleasure or interest in activities
feelings of excessive guilt or low self-worth
feeling very tired or low in energy
prevention: interventions for parents of children with behavioural problems
risk_factors: people who have lived through abuse or severe losses
complications: difficulties in all aspects of life
problems at school and at work
key_facts: an estimated 5.7% of adults suffer from depression
more women are affected by depression than men
approximately 332 million people in the world have depression
in 2021, an estimated 727 000 people lost their lives to suicide
